info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Terminal Operational Actions API
info.description: The Card Terminal Operational Actions API enables businesses to manage various operational tasks related to card terminals within banking channels. This API facilitates actions such as configuring terminal settings, updating operational parameters, and initiating specific functionalities to enhance transaction efficiency. Typical consumers include banking institutions and payment service providers looking to streamline their card processing operations. The API ensures that the management of card terminals is seamless and responsive, addressing real-time operational needs in the banking ecosystem.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for a card terminal.
